# Pull Request Rules Checklist

- [x] All PR titles follow conventional commits format (e.g., feat:, fix:, refactor:).
- [x] Code adheres to repository style (Ruff 100-character line length, type annotations).
- [x] Test coverage floor (>=96%) is preserved or improved.
- [x] PR descriptions begin with the SakJules persona identifier.
- [x] No credentials, private tokens, or secrets are committed.
